verdict.rationale: Mangopay's wallet infrastructure lets platforms hold funds indefinitely and release them on triggers (payins to wallet, payouts on demand, disputes/chargebacks documented), which supports escrow-like fund holding until delivery/dispute windows pass. However, there's no dedicated 'escrow' product documentation, no explicit dispute-window timers, and no clear API mechanics for scheduling delayed release tied to delivery confirmation — developers must build that logic themselves atop wallets/payouts. missing for 10: dedicated escrow/hold-period feature docs, explicit dispute-window duration/timers, built-in scheduled-release triggers, independent developer validation of this escrow pattern.
